summary: Verify noVNC preview availability before opening recovered sessions

delivery.outcome: Verify actual noVNC HTTP preview availability and stop stale unavailable previews; deliver tested commit and PR, with protected OneDev/Validator merge only when an independently configured profile exists.
nonGoals: No recovery engine, dependency manifest, Willmux catalog/UI, user session restart, SSH transfer, protected CI profile or production service changes.
HTTP readiness does not attest an authenticated RFB session or recovered RAM/PTY.

architecture.decision: Use a direct loopback HTTP GET without proxy or redirects; require bounded successful noVNC HTML. Gate frames and separate-window links by observed preview availability. Preserve session identity and existing API shape.

evidence: Real isolated browser request/readback and HTTP negative-probe receipt

architecture.rollback: Revert this ticket implementation commit; no runtime state migration.

commands: Run real local HTTP readiness positive/negative tests, including unrelated service, redirects, missing page, oversized content and timeouts.
validation.evidence: Only bounded noVNC HTML is available; failed previews are stopped.

commands: Run isolated Chromium with active/stopped inventory and stale selected URL, then refresh after availability changes.
validation.evidence: Available sessions open independently; stopped sessions have no frame or actionable separate-window link.

commands: Run focused APX and full Uncrash tests and managed governance.
validation.evidence: Commit/PR is exact-head validated; protected publication remains pending absent independently deployed profiles.
